static_traits.name: Guo Lei
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友的关系因Self-doubt和Low mood而紧张,较少向他人谈及内心困扰
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness;without既往心理治疗或精神科治疗史
static_traits.language_features: Neutral attitude,表达清晰,能具体描述问题与trigger情境,配合度较好

basic_info.main_problem: 我报名参加电视节目<The Voice>,但我not断怀疑自己的能力,觉得自己永远not够好,not会被选中.
basic_info.core_demands: 我想摆脱这些Self-doubt的感受,能够重新享受生活,而not再持续担心自己是否够好.

special_situations.event: When watching the show 'The Voice', compares with other contestants' performances
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的水平not如其他选手,就说明I am not good enough,not会被选中
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles practice and seeks feedback from friends to prove oneself
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我的声音比not上他们,我肯定not会被选上

special_situations.event: 提交申请后长期not yet收到节目组回复
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果have not很快得到回应,就意味着I am not good enough或已Being rejected
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated thinking and worrying, avoids discussing this matter with others
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: have not消息就是坏消息,我一定not行

special_situations.event: Thinking about one's audition and the judges' evaluation
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能表现得足够完美,就会被negate和羞辱
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Practices even harder, chooses safer pieces, and seeks feedback cautiously
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will perform very badly; the result will only embarrass me more

special_situations.event: Imagines singing in front of friends and receiving real feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果朋友觉得我not好,说明我客观上not够好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Distances friends, reduces interaction to avoid negative evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会认为我唱得not好,会看not起我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and seen (hopes one's singing is accepted and affirmed)
core_conflict.fear: 害怕Being rejected,被羞辱或被证明'not够好'
defense_goal: 通过保持谨慎与Self-doubt来降低被negate的风险
Keeps a certain distance from others to avoid being hurt

object_relations.self_representation: not够好的竞争者/可能被negate的自我

object_relations.object_representation: 可能看not起我的他人/朋友

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当长时间not yet收到节目方的任何回复或反馈时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将Silence理解为拒绝与negate,感觉自己已经被判定'not够好'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以假设他人负面评价的方式表达,如'他们肯定觉得我not行',语气谨慎,带Self-denial色彩,减少展开细节

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited or imagining singing in front of friends and collecting feedback
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将朋友视为苛刻的评判者,Anticipation反馈会羞辱自己
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: useSelf-deprecation的语句,减少眼神接触,语气压低,主动降低自我价值以躲避外在评价

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor points out his catastrophizing and invites a behavioral experiment
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Feels scrutinized and required to prove oneself, thus turns to rational discussion to avoid emotional exposure
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use理论化,抽象化的语言,讨论方法与流程,弱化个人感受与脆弱处,语气平稳,客观

manifestations: 与朋友的关系因Self-doubt而紧张
not与朋友和同事讨论自己的Self-doubt
Social withdrawal,Low mood时与他人保持距离
outcomes: Sense of isolation与not被理解感增加

manifestations: Self-doubt影响日常兴趣与爱好(如阅读)
WorkDecreased drive,注意力被试唱占据

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others,与'拥有'对应,常表现为'他们在看not起我'等
manifestations: 担心朋友会看not起自己的歌声

contact_model.definition: 个体存在not良的自我Reflection和过度自我限制,自我苛责,对接触过于小心谨慎,与'自主性'对应
manifestations: Scrutinizing one's performance with harsh standards
在反馈尚not yet出现前先行设想负面后果

positive_force: Has basic social support (friends and colleagues to communicate with)
Proactively practices and seeks feedback; willing to take behavioral experiments
有动机改善Self-doubt与提升生活质量
职业纪律与执行力(Naval personnel背景)
negative_force: Cognitive patterns of catastrophizing and over-predicting negative outcomes
与他人比较并negate自我(Comparing and Despairing)
Excessively relies on external evaluation, lacks inner self-affirmation
Attention occupied by the audition, impairing work and interests

target_behavior.behavior: 观看<The Voice>或想到试唱时出现强烈Self-denial与Anxiety
antecedent: Thinking about one's audition and being judged
target_behavior.core_reason: 对'I am not good enough'的核心信念与灾难化,预测not yet来的认知扭曲被激活
target_behavior.function: Escaping potential failure and humiliation, seeking a brief psychological sense of security
target_behavior.consequence: Persistent anxiety与Self-doubt,Decline in work concentration,Low mood

target_behavior.behavior: 因Self-doubt而疏远朋友,Reduced socializing与兴趣参与
antecedent: Anticipation在朋友面前演唱并收集反馈
Thinking about evaluation when interacting with friends
target_behavior.core_reason: 将他人设定为苛刻评判者并进行读心术,担心被negate
target_behavior.function: Avoids negative evaluation and embarrassment; reduces the risk of being hurt
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension,Increased sense of isolation,生活可享受性下降
